decisions.reason: The source changes only Big Block prize parameters; the independent Small Block mechanism remains unchanged.
Referral mints still issue one Small Block and one Big Block ticket, and the ticket-cycle rules remain valid relative to their corresponding draws.
The change to Big Block prize amount and draw trigger does not alter no-referral recipient selection or ticket allocation.
Separate ticket counters and their reset-after-draw behavior remain valid despite the changed Big Block draw parameters.
The source retains five winners and does not change random ticket-weighted selection, eligible population semantics, or applicable draws.
The source does not change the manual prize-claim and delivery mode.
Publishing current prize-pool values remains required; the candidate stores no obsolete Big Block amount or trigger.
The Big Block ticket counter remains applicable, and the source does not change which counters or badges appear in NFT metadata.
The automatic $5 referral commission is independent of the changed Big Block prize amount and draw trigger.
The source does not disable or otherwise modify secondary-sale royalty enforcement.
The first-referral badge trigger is unrelated to the Big Block prize parameter adjustment.
The source does not change unauthenticated access to public APIs or the categories of public data exposed.
